import json,subprocess,sys
def audit(cap):
 d={'seed':'s','definitions':[],'timeout_ms':1,'cases':[],'events':[],'channels':[{'name':'c','parts':[{'case':None,'data':cap.decode('latin1')}]}]}
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','main.py'],input=json.dumps(d).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
 return json.loads(p.stdout)['channels'][0]
req=b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'
# seven max content lines: X: + 8190 val
lines=[]
for i in range(7): lines.append(b'X:'+b'a'*8190+b'\r\n')
lines.append(b'Y:'+b'a'*8156+b'\r\n') # physical 8160 content8158? check
cap=req+b''.join(lines)+b'\r\n'
print('len',len(cap),'block',len(cap))
print('exact',audit(cap)['error'])
cap2=req+b''.join(lines[:-1])+b'Y:'+b'a'*8157+b'\r\n\r\n'
print('over len',len(cap2),audit(cap2)['error'])
# field count 128/129 using X:a lines physical4
reqline=b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'
for n in [128,129]:
 cap=reqline+b'X:a\r\n'*n+b'\r\n'
